[attribute-license-type]
=== `@license-type` Type of License

Type of license described by the <<element-license,`<license>`>> element.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-license,`<license>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The type of license, for example, “`open-access`”
                        for a license permitting unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any
                        medium, provided the original work is properly cited; or
                        “`ccc`” for a Copyright Clearance Center
                        statement.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
